title: Remote Signing On
description: Covers the procedures for signing on for duty remotely, handling communication issues, and receiving notices.

knowledgeUnits.concept: How do you sign on remotely?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Check notice cases, read/sign readiness statement. Call depot manager using provided phone/number (0330 109 8325/8326). State name, location, duty signing on for. Confirm possession of Altered Workings (AW) and correct publications.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Send a text message to the depot manager with your duty number.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Log in via a web portal using your employee ID.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Report to the nearest station master to sign on.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Remote signing on involves checking notices, confirming readiness, and then phoning the depot manager, providing specific details (name, location, duty), and confirming possession of necessary documents like AWs and publications.

knowledgeUnits.concept: What action would you take if unable to contact the depot manager for remote sign on?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Call control / SDC (Service Delivery Centre) on 0330 109 8352 or 0330 109 8353.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Wait 15 minutes and try calling the depot manager again.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Proceed to the depot to sign on in person.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Assume permission is granted and start the duty.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: If the depot manager cannot be reached for remote sign-on, the backup procedure is to contact Control / SDC directly using the specified numbers.

knowledgeUnits.concept: How do you receive your notices when signing on remotely?
knowledgeUnits.definition: Sign for WON's, PON's and STN's and pick them up at the signing on points. They can also be downloaded and viewed on the iPad via the RC Documents app.
knowledgeUnits.distractor1: Notices are read out over the phone by the depot manager.
knowledgeUnits.distractor2: Notices are sent via email after signing on.
knowledgeUnits.distractor3: Notices are only available physically at the main depot.
knowledgeUnits.explanation: Even when signing on remotely, drivers are responsible for obtaining relevant notices (WON, PON, STN). These can be collected physically from signing-on points or accessed digitally via the company-provided iPad app.
